title: Funding Desk Standards: Wire Release Figures by Closing Method (Closing and Funding)
content:
These are the Closing and Funding desk's standing figures for when funds go out after signing, how long the gap from signing to funding may run, the same-day wire cutoffs, the release preconditions, and the treatment of a returned wire. Times are US Eastern.

| Closing method | Funding after signing, no rescission (business days) | Longest signing-to-funding gap before verifications are redone (business days) | Funding request cutoff for a same-day wire | Same-day wire release cutoff | Returned-wire re-send (business days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur Traditional Wet Closing | 0 | 2 | 12:00 | 14:00 | 1 |
| Larkspur Escrow Dry-Funding Closing | 2 | 3 | 12:00 | 14:00 | 1 |
| Larkspur Mobile Notary Closing | 0 | 2 | 12:00 | 14:00 | 1 |
| Larkspur Hybrid eClosing | 0 | 2 | 12:00 | 14:00 | 1 |
| Larkspur Remote Online Notarization Closing | 0 | 2 | 12:00 | 14:00 | 1 |
| Larkspur Power of Attorney Closing | 0 | 2 | 12:00 | 14:00 | 1 |
| Larkspur Mail-Away Closing | 2 | 5 | 12:00 | 14:00 | 1 |

## Release preconditions and returned-wire interest

| Standard | All seven methods |
|---|---|
| Every prior-to-funding condition must be cleared before the wire is released | Yes |
| The rate lock must still be in force on the disbursement date | Yes |
| The settlement agent must be on Larkspur's approved list | Yes |
| A closing protection letter must be issued for the settlement agent | Yes |
| Interest for days lost to a wire returned for a Larkspur-side reason is refunded to the borrower | Yes |

## Notes

- "Funding after signing" is the number of business days after signing on which funds are wired when no rescission applies; 0 means the wire goes out on the signing day.
- The returned-wire re-send figure is the number of business days within which a wire returned for a Larkspur-side reason is re-sent.
- Example (hypothetical): under the Larkspur Mail-Away Closing, a signing on a Monday with no rescission is wired 2 business days later, on Wednesday; the gap may run up to 5 business days before employment and credit verifications are redone.
